items.reason: Gap 0 describes overlapping duplicate deliveries that both check before the id is inserted and both execute the handler.
Gap 2 describes a signed body delivered with a changed X-Event-Id header, which changes the de-duplication key.
Gap 3 states that the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, causing refunds to be dropped.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
